title: I made a pop-up book you can walk intoe
author: SuruiMakesGames
selftext:
Hi! Origami World is a small, cozy exploration game set inside a pop-up book. Walk around, and the paper houses fold up around you as you go.

* 5 paper worlds: a seaside harbor, a lantern canal town, a desert bazaar, an aurora snowfield, and an observatory above the clouds
* Little jobs in each one: fishing, river lanterns, kite flying, curling, star charts
* Day / dusk / night, houses you can walk into, gliding as a paper plane, and the occasional paper rain

I made this game with Claude. Let me know what you think and how can I improve. Thanks!
